plan.notes: Source: Alaska Bible College official program page 'Bachelor of Arts in Biblical Studies and Christian Ministry' (akbible.edu/babibleandministry): Program Requirements (120 Credits: Biblical Studies 39 + Christian Ministry 33 + General Education 33 + Electives 15) plus the published 8-semester DEGREE SEQUENCE. Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. The degree sequence is transcribed course-by-course; all 8 semesters sum to 120 cr. Catalog quirks (transcribed as published in the sequence, flagged here): (1) the requirements list gives the Integrated Theology Seminar as BI-TH4103 (both halves), but the degree sequence lists BI-TH4101 (Fall Senior) and BI-TH4102 (Spring Senior); the sequence codes are used in this file. (2) The requirements list gives Old Testament Survey II as BI-OT1102, but the Spring Sophomore sequence lists BI-TH1102; the sequence code is used in this file. (3) The requirements list gives Doctrines I as BI-TH3101, but both degree sequences on the site list it as BI-TH2101; the sequence code is used in this file. (4) CM-CD1101/CM-CD1201 etc. marked ** are catalog core courses (C or better required). (5) Emphasis electives: the program offers emphasis tracks (Discipleship, Intercultural Ministry, New Testament, New Testament Greek, Old Testament, Pastoral Studies, Apologetics, Theology, Worship Arts, Biblical Counseling); the four 'Christian Ministry (Emphasis) Elective' slots (12 cr) are filled from the chosen emphasis's course list — see the emphasis course options below.
